analysis_plan.data: GSE324210 raw counts + metadata (sex, age, baseline VO2max, adherence)
analysis_plan.primary_test: Spearman correlation between module score (pre) and delta-VO2max (post-pre)
analysis_plan.sample_split: random 2:1 train:test, seed=42, stratified by sex
analysis_plan.threshold: BH-FDR < 0.05 at gene level; module-level reported with N and CI

author: ichor
note: Kill criterion: if 0/primary and 0/secondary endpoints met, FME sub-hypothesis is dead
primary_hypothesis: Pre-training expression of the training-attenuated module (dip-score-selected genes) predicts VO2max change after endurance intervention
question: Does the FME (exercise-attenuated gene module, from GSE324210) distinguish responders from non-responders at baseline?
